audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart gives Galio 5 of 7 stages while the real win rate (54.28%) favors Soraka; defects flag confirms the contradiction.
audit.why: Soraka's Equinox (E, 20/19/18/17/16s) threatens Galio's engage range and silences his combo mid-cast, and Justice Punch (E, 11/10/9/8/7s) is his only gap-closer — once tracked, Soraka out-poke-sustains him from level 3 onward outside his Level 6/R spike.
audit.corrected: Flip Level 3, Levels 4-5, First item, and 2+ items to Soraka; keep Level 6 with Galio since Hero's Entrance is a genuine spike.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns has zero digits despite both champions having well-defined, matchup-relevant cooldowns.
audit.why: Justice Punch is Galio's only engage tool (11/10/9/8/7s) and Equinox is Soraka's answer to it (20/19/18/17/16s) — naming both numbers is exactly the concrete sequencing the defects flag asks for.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns now states both real cooldown curves and how they interact.

audit.whatIsWrong: Neither the auto-reset tell on Colossal Smash (P) nor the terrain-blocking nature of Justice Punch (E) reaches the page; two Do's/Don'ts bullets are copy-paste bleed from tradeGood/tradeBad instead.
audit.why: missingInteractions flags both as applicable-but-unmentioned; the bleed bullets fail COPY_PASTE_BLEED lint (dosFull[1].d, dontsFull[2].d).
audit.corrected: dosFull[1] rewritten around max-range healing vs Justice Punch's 650 range; dontsFull[2] rewritten around Colossal Smash's auto-reset tell and Justice Punch cutting retreat.

edits.before: - Galio Justice Punch: matchup-defining — His dash knockup — he has no engage while it is down. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep E Equinox banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Justice Punch (E) is 11/10/9/8/7s and his only gap-closer — track it, since he has no engage without it. - Your Equinox (E) is 20/19/18/17/16s: bank it for his engage window, not chip poke. - His R is 180/160/140s — a fight decision, not a habit.
